verdict.rationale: PlanetScale ships an official, documented MCP server (hosted, with service-token auth for CI/headless agents) that connects Claude, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible agents to PlanetScale databases and Insights, corroborated by a dedicated docs page and probe hit. Missing for 10: independent hands-on community verification of the MCP server itself (only vendor docs cited, no third-party report of using it).
